# Vendored files (prototype only)

Copied unmodified from npm, except: source-map comments stripped from the Tabler CSS/JS, and the icon font CSS keeps only the woff2 source.
Nothing is loaded from a CDN; the pages work from `file://`.

| Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| @tabler/core (css + js, includes Bootstrap 5) | 1.4.0 | MIT |
| @tabler/icons-webfont | 3.49.0 | MIT |
| sortablejs | 1.15.7 | MIT |
| @fontsource/inter, @fontsource/jetbrains-mono (assets/fonts) | 5.x | OFL-1.1 |
